$comment: TODO: Replace every TODO_ placeholder before running the demo.
projects[].id: short slug used in (project, user) membership tuples.
projects[].policy.allow: glob list of admitted model targets; '*' admits all.
projects[].policy.min_quality: minimum quality_prior a model must have to be routed to.
credentials.mode: 'project_only' means the project supplies the frontier key, not the user.
credentials.providers: map of provider name -> {env_var, kind}.
env_var: the shell variable the server reads at startup for the API key.
kind: always 'api_key' for token-based frontier credentials.
users[].id: short slug; paired with a project in keys[].
keys[]: one entry per (project, user) membership.
key_sha256: run mint_keys.py to fill this in — never put the secret here.
admin_keys: filled in by mint_keys.py; empty by default.
NOTE: frontier_cadence and degrade_to_local should only be set if a local fleet is wired.
With no local fleet, these settings cause the server to refuse to start.
